Private first half of memory_refresh_aliases: the derived rows are cleared and then immediately recomputed and reinserted. Exposing the delete on its own would offer a capability no caller wants and would split the rebuild across the process boundary, so a failure between the delete and the reinserts would leave the memory stripped of its derived rows. The composite refresh is the operation that migrates; this half never runs alone.
